feeds.title: Kate Scarlata RDN, Fodmap & IBS Expert
feeds.description: I'm Kate. — Registered dietitian, mom, runner, author and low fodmap diet educator. After a major intestinal resection, i'm not only a health care provider but also a patient. I'm on a mission to spread global awareness of the low fodmap diet for those who suffer from functional gut disorders.

feeds.title: A Little Bit Yummy Blog
feeds.description: A Little Bit Yummy helps people love their low FODMAP lives by providing delicious recipes & up-to-date resources. All recipes are dietitian approved.

feeds.title: FODMAP Everyday
feeds.description: Do you have IBS? Looking for information about the low FODMAP diet for IBS? Want low FODMAP diet recipes, information, and support? It's all here! We help you THRIVE on the Low FODMAP diet and beyond! Delicious Certified Low FODMAP recipes, informative articles, support from RDN's and so much more!

feeds.title: Casa de sante
feeds.description: Living with IBS can be difficult, but Casa de Sante makes it easier with a wide variety of low FODMAP foods and products.

feeds.title: Loveable Lemons
feeds.description: Learn how to adapt your favorite recipes into Low FODMAP recipes. After a medical diagnosis places you on a difficult food journey, learn how to make good, delicious food again! It turns what feels like a sour lemon into recipes that make them loveable again.

feeds.title: Burnt Apple
feeds.description: Covers articles about easy food allergy friendly cooking, gluten and dairy free recipes that are ready in under 30 minutes with 10 Ingredients or less!

feeds.title: Rachel Pauls Food
feeds.description: Dr. Rachel Pauls founded Rachel Pauls Food to help people more easily manage their digestive issues and live healthier, happier lives. A physician, a mother of three and mission-driven entrepreneur, Dr. Pauls follows a low-FODMAP food plan to eliminate her own symptoms of Irritable Bowel Syndrome.

feeds.title: FUN WITHOUT FODMAPS
feeds.description: Fun without Fodmaps is a fun, food blog focusing on easy, low fodmap recipes and empowering you to feel better and achieve well being.

feeds.title: Karlijn's Kitchen
feeds.description: On Karlijn's Kitchen, you find low FODMAP recipes, gluten-free, lactose-free recipes and lifestyle blogs. Because also with intolerances you should be able to enjoy food!

feeds.title: Ignite Nutrition Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Based in Calgary, Ignite Nutrition offers Canada-wide nutrition & psychology counselling, specializing in gut health. Plus, nutritious recipes and tips.

feeds.title: Erika's Gluten-free Kitchen
feeds.description: Gluten-free recipes, tips, and news, all with a focus on minimizing IBS irritation by taking a low-FODMAP diet approach.

feeds.title: IBS Game Changer Blog
feeds.description: Deliciously low fodmap recipes, helpful tools, & expert guidance for low fodmap eating. Authored by Katherine Aitken-Young, a Registered Nurse, nutritionist, and foodie with Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).

feeds.title: She Can't Eat What?! Blog
feeds.description: She Can't Eat What?! is a health and wellness recipe blog dedicated to simple Low FODMAP living.

feeds.title: Delicious as it Looks
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Dianne, the author and creator behind Delicious as it Looks. After suffering from IBS for more than twenty years, I was so happy to find relief with the low-FODMAP protocol. Delicious as it Looks blog is about low-FODMAP recipes and food for treating IBS.

feeds.title: IBS-Free At Last!
feeds.description: Low-FODMAP diet resources for people with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). Tools and workshops for healthcare providers. Edited by Patsy Catsos, MS, RDN, LD, author of IBS--Free at Last! and the Flavor without FODMAP Cookbook.

feeds.title: Strands of My Life Blog
feeds.description: On my blog, you can find many recipes, videos and articles on the Low Fodmap diet for irritable bowel syndrome to help eliminate your symptoms. My name is Suzanne Perazzini, your IBS Liberator. I am a nutritional therapist specializing in IBS and the low Fodmap diet.

feeds.title: FODY Food Co
feeds.description: At FODY Food Co, we understand the needs for special diets, trusted brands, and high quality, great tasting products.

feeds.title: The FODMAP Formula
feeds.description: My name is Amy, and I want to welcome you to The FODMAP Formula. As a fellow IBS sufferer, I have felt sick, embarrassed, and, once I started the Low FODMAP diet, very hungry! Let me show you what I've learned from my research, my support network, and some old fashioned trial and error. I am confident that together we can get the Low FODMAP Diet down to a science!

feeds.title: Stephanie Clairmont Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie Clairmont is a Digestive Health Dietitian. Helping you improve digestive symptoms with the low fodmap diet and next step strategies.

feeds.title: Lauren Renlund MPH RD
feeds.description: I'm a Canadian registered dietitian & nutrition coach who blogs about digestive health & good food. All of the recipes I post are low FODMAP & gluten-free!

feeds.title: My Gut Feeling
feeds.description: My Gut Feeling blog is about low FODMAP, gluten-free and low lactose healthy recipes both in English and Portuguese.

feeds.title: Low Fodmap
feeds.description: Low FODMAP food blogger based in Hampshire following a gluten free, low lactose and nut free diet for IBS. Ideas and recipes for a happy, healthy gut.

feeds.title: FODMAP Blog
feeds.description: Dietetics clinic located in Ringwood providing specialty services in the area of IBS, sugar intolerance/malabsorption and the low FODMAP diet.

feeds.title: Bay's Kitchen
feeds.description: Each month we will bring you the latest news which has caught our attention, regarding the Low FODMAP Diet, IBS and other gastrointestinal issues. Evidence suggests fructans, which are a type of sugar chain found in wheat, barley and rye, as well as onions, garlic, chickpeas, cabbage, and artichokes are actually what many are intolerant to - not gluten.

feeds.title: Go Messy or Go Hungry Blog
feeds.description: GMGH is a blog for people following the low FODMAP diet. Find delicious & healthy recipes, as well as tips and tricks for feeling your best!

feeds.title: Friendly Little Kitchen
feeds.description: I'm Stephanie born and raised in Melbourne, Australia, I am a marketer by trade and a food lover and blogger by heart. Friendly Little Kitchen shares the love for food, cooking and healthy living while embracing food intolerances. Low FODMAP, gluten free, fructose & lactose friendly recipes.

feeds.title: Everyday Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Marnie and Joanna Baker is an experienced FODMAP-trained dietitian consulting at Everyday Nutrition.

feeds.title: The Roasted Root
feeds.description: I'm Julia Mueller, your recipe developer, photographer, cookbook author, and shenanigans-writer here at The Roasted Root. You will find nutrient-rich low-inflammatory or anti-inflammatory recipes that are primarily centered around vegetables and meat. I specialize in recipes that are focused on dietary restrictions vegetarian, vegan, paleo, keto and gluten-free eaters will find a plethora of meal options here, as well as folks who eat a Low-FODMAP diet.

feeds.title: FODMAP Life
feeds.description: FODMAP Life is meant to help others who have IBS, Celiac Disease, or IBD (Crohn's or Ulcerative Colitis), and autoimmune diseases like Hashimoto's (a thyroid disease). The focus is the low-Fodmap Diet, as well as other natural ways to help care for the body and mind authored by Certified Nutritionist Consultant Colleen Francioli.

feeds.title: The Sane Kitchen
feeds.description: The Sane Kitchen hopes to inspire and encourage people who need, want, or have been instructed to 'change' their diet. Changing how you eat is never easy and most of us can use all the help we can get. It may not be easy to change your diet but the benefits can be life-changing. We specifically try to help those individuals who are attempting a Gluten Free Diet or Low FODMAP Diet, but anyone can enjoy the recipes provided

feeds.title: Gluten Free Cuppa Tea
feeds.description: Gluten free blog based in London, UK. Tried & tested award-winning recipes that are low FODMAP & dairy free too. Follow this blog for plenty of recipes & reviews that are applicable to those living gluten free, dairy free, sugar free, egg free & even living a vegan life style.

feeds.title: The IBS Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: Kirsten Jackson writes about irritable bowel syndrome(IBS), low fodmap diet, low fodmap recipes, gut health, targeting nutrition, sleep, movement, and mental wellbeing. She is a consultant gastroenterology dietitian and founder of The Food Treatment Clinic - a service for those with IBS.

feeds.title: Antonella Dewell Blog
feeds.description: Antonella Dewell is a Registered Dietitian in Santa Cruz, California who is passionate about empowering people with IBS to live a life free of their painful and life-disrupting symptoms while enjoying the most varied and nutritious diet.
